pit-crew.flag-yellow-local.comment: A local yellow is shown for an incident ahead — one short warning to slow down and mind the stopped cars. A full-course yellow takes the flag-yellow-full line instead.
pit-crew.flag-yellow-local.test: Harness → Flags → Yellow (local). In-sim: drive up to a stopped or spun car in a local yellow sector.

pit-crew.flag-yellow-full.comment: A full-course yellow is out — tells the driver the pace car is being deployed and to close up safely.
pit-crew.flag-yellow-full.test: Harness → Flags → Yellow (full). In-sim: a full-course caution in an oval race (the pace car is deployed).

pit-crew.flag-yellow-cleared.comment: The yellow has been withdrawn — a short all-clear, replayed after a busier line finishes rather than dropped.
pit-crew.flag-yellow-cleared.test: Harness → Flags → Yellow Cleared. In-sim: clear the local yellow sector, or the caution ends and racing resumes.

pit-crew.flag-green.comment: The green flag at the start of a session or a restart. The wording differs per session type (practice, qualifying, race), so it branches on session.type; an unknown session type takes the race line.
pit-crew.flag-green.test: Harness → Flags → Green, after choosing a session preset (practice, qualifying or race). In-sim: the green at the start of any session, or at a race restart.

pit-crew.flag-blue.comment: A faster car is about to lap the driver — asks for mirrors and a clean pass.
pit-crew.flag-blue.test: Harness → Flags → Blue. In-sim: get shown the blue flag as a lapping car closes in.

pit-crew.flag-white.comment: The white flag — the leader's final lap in a race, or the last lap of a practice or qualifying session; the wording follows session.type, and an unknown session type takes the race line.
pit-crew.flag-white.test: Harness → Flags → White, after choosing a session preset. In-sim: the white flag comes out on the leader's final lap (race) or on your own last lap (practice, qualifying).

pit-crew.flag-white-last-lap.comment: The driver has crossed the line under the white flag and started their own last lap — give it everything. Race-only; stage two of the white-flag call.
pit-crew.flag-white-last-lap.test: Harness → Flags → White — Last Lap Started, with the race session preset. In-sim: cross start/finish while the white flag flies in a race.

pit-crew.flag-white-leader.comment: The overall leader has started their final lap while the driver is still some way behind — a heads-up that the race is about to end.
pit-crew.flag-white-leader.test: Harness → Flags → Leader's final lap, with the race session preset. In-sim: in a race, let the leader take the white flag while you are a lap or more down.

pit-crew.flag-red.comment: The red flag — the session is stopped; tells the driver to slow down and drive carefully back to the pits.
pit-crew.flag-red.test: Harness → Flags → Red. In-sim: a red flag in a hosted or league session.

pit-crew.flag-black.comment: A black flag has been issued — the driver has a penalty to serve within three laps.
pit-crew.flag-black.test: Harness → Flags → Black. In-sim: speed in the pit lane, or ignore a furled black flag; a race admin can also issue one (!black).

pit-crew.flag-checkered.comment: The checkered flag — the session is over. The wording follows session.type (the well-done only after a race); an unknown session type takes the race line.
pit-crew.flag-checkered.test: Harness → Flags → Checkered, after choosing a session preset. In-sim: take the checkered flag at the end of any session.

pit-crew.flag-debris.comment: A debris flag — something is on the track ahead; asks the driver to be careful.
pit-crew.flag-debris.test: Harness → Flags → Debris. In-sim: the debris flag after an incident leaves parts on the track.

pit-crew.flag-meatball.comment: The meatball flag — mandatory repairs, the driver must pit. Cuts any other line in flight and is never dropped.
pit-crew.flag-meatball.test: Harness → Flags → Meatball. In-sim: take enough damage that iRacing orders you in for repairs.

pit-crew.flag-disqualify.comment: The driver has been disqualified — pull off the track.
pit-crew.flag-disqualify.test: Harness → Flags → Disqualify. In-sim: exceed the session's incident limit, or a race admin disqualifies you (!dq).

pit-crew.flag-furled.comment: The furled black flag — the driver gained time and must give it back. Spoken only while the flag is still shown at speak time, so a warning withdrawn while this waited behind a longer line stays silent.
pit-crew.flag-furled.test: Harness → Flags → Furled. In-sim: cut a corner and gain time; the furled flag shows until the time is given back.

pit-crew.flag-furled-cleared.comment: The furled warning has been withdrawn after the driver gave the time back. Only follows a furled line that was actually spoken, and never plays when the warning escalated to a real black flag instead.
pit-crew.flag-furled-cleared.test: Harness → Flags → Furled, then Harness → Flags → Furled Cleared. In-sim: give the time back after a furled black flag.

pit-crew.flag-dq-scoring-invalid.comment: The driver has been disqualified and their scoring invalidated — DQ, scoring's off.
pit-crew.flag-dq-scoring-invalid.test: Harness → Flags → DQ — Scoring Invalid. In-sim: a disqualification that also invalidates scoring (rare; the harness is the practical route).

pit-crew.flag-crossed.comment: Crossed flags — the halfway point of the race. Race-only, while the driver is live in the car.
pit-crew.flag-crossed.test: Harness → Flags → Crossed, with the race session preset and the hot-lap telemetry preset. In-sim: reach the halfway point of an oval race.

pit-crew.flag-one-pace-lap-to-go.comment: One more pace lap before the green on a rolling start — keep the spacing tidy and warm the tyres. Race-only, live in the car.
pit-crew.flag-one-pace-lap-to-go.test: Harness → Flags → One Pace Lap to Go, with the race session preset and the hot-lap telemetry preset. In-sim: the second-to-last pace lap of a rolling start.

pit-crew.flag-green-held.comment: The pace car is pulling in and the green is imminent — get ready to launch. Rolling starts and restarts only; a standing-start grid is the start lights' business.
pit-crew.flag-green-held.test: Harness → Flags → Green Held, with the race session preset and the hot-lap telemetry preset. In-sim: the final pace lap of a rolling start or restart, once the pace car peels off.

pit-crew.flag-ten-to-go.comment: Ten laps to go. Race-only, live in the car.
pit-crew.flag-ten-to-go.test: Harness → Flags → Ten to Go, with the race session preset and the hot-lap telemetry preset. In-sim: ten laps remaining in an oval race.

pit-crew.flag-five-to-go.comment: Five laps to go. Race-only, live in the car.
pit-crew.flag-five-to-go.test: Harness → Flags → Five to Go, with the race session preset and the hot-lap telemetry preset. In-sim: five laps remaining in an oval race.

pit-crew.flag-yellow-waving.comment: A waving yellow — a fresh incident right ahead, more urgent than the standing yellow. Repeats at most once per 30 seconds while the incident persists.
pit-crew.flag-yellow-waving.test: Harness → Flags → Yellow Waving. In-sim: approach a sector where a car has just crashed or spun.

pit-crew.flag-caution-waving.comment: The caution is out and waving — slow down and close up safely. Repeats at most once per 30 seconds.
pit-crew.flag-caution-waving.test: Harness → Flags → Caution Waving. In-sim: the caution comes out on an oval as the field bunches up.

radio.comment: The walkie-talkie frame: an open tick, the pit-lane ambience bed, a close tick.
